body:
# CreaTive Command

CreaTive Command is a lightweight Minecraft admin utility plugin for Paper servers.
It provides useful moderation and player-management commands in a simple and easy-to-use format.

## Features

* Heal players instantly
* Set player saturation and hunger
* Open player Ender Chests
* View player inventories live
* Lightweight and beginner-friendly
* Built for modern Paper versions

## Commands

### `/heal <player> <1-20>`

Sets a player's health.

### `/saturation <player> <0-20>`

Sets a player's saturation and hunger level.

### `/enderchest <player>`

Opens a player's Ender Chest.

### `/invsee <player>`

View and edit a player's inventory live.

## Server Software

* Paper 1.21+
* Spigot compatible (basic support)

## Plugin Goals

Simple Command focuses on:

* clean code
* lightweight performance
* useful moderation utilities
* beginner-friendly setup

Perfect for admin servers.
